78129-the-nature-lover-s-knapsack.title: The Nature Lover S Knapsack
78129-the-nature-lover-s-knapsack.creator: Unknown
78129-the-nature-lover-s-knapsack.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. I would not for the world deprive any one of this pleasure. I only hope that this knapsack of nature poetry will be found a worthy travelling companion for every nature lover. It cannot be exhaustive, and it is in no sense a reference book. Its only purpose is to serve as a friendly guide to many of the most beautiful nature poems by English and American authors.

arxiv-2208-01752.title: InsightiGen: a versatile tool to generate insight for an academic systematic literature review
arxiv-2208-01752.creator: Ardeshir Shojaeinasab, Masoud Jalayer, Homayoun Najjaran
arxiv-2208-01752.description: Abstract A comprehensive literature review has always been an essential first step of every meaningful research. In recent years, however, the availability of a vast amount of information in both open-access and subscription-based literature in every field has made it difficult, if not impossible, to be certain about the comprehensiveness of one’s survey.

arxiv-2208-11726.title: Wasserstein Task Embedding for Measuring Task Similarities
arxiv-2208-11726.creator: Xinran Liu, Yikun Bai, Yuzhe Lu, Andrea Soltoggio, Soheil Kolouri
arxiv-2208-11726.description: Abstract Measuring similarities between different tasks is critical in a broad spectrum of machine learning problems, including transfer, multi-task, continual, and meta-learning. Most current approaches to measuring task similarities are architecture-dependent: 1) relying on pre-trained models, or 2) training networks on tasks and using forward transfer as a proxy for task similarity.

arxiv-2405-00367.title: Distance Sampling-based Paraphraser Leveraging ChatGPT for Text Data Manipulation Conference: Proceedings of the 47th International ACM SIGIR Conference on Research and Development in Information Retrieval; July 14–18, 2024; Washington, DC, USA Proceedings of the 47th International ACM SIGIR Confere
arxiv-2405-00367.creator: Yoori Oh, Yoseob Han, Kyogu Lee
arxiv-2405-00367.description: Abstract . There has been growing interest in audio-language retrieval research, where the objective is to establish the correlation between audio and text modalities. However, most audio-text paired datasets often lack rich expression of the text data compared to the audio samples.

arxiv-2508-20022.title: Evidence of Titanate Clouds in the Day-side Atmosphere of the Ultra-Hot Jupiter WASP-121b
arxiv-2508-20022.creator: Suman Saha, James S. Jenkins
arxiv-2508-20022.description: Abstract The day-side atmospheres of the hottest ultra-hot Jupiters (UHJs) have long been subject to speculation about cloud formation, often without direct observational evidence. Here, we present a detailed analysis of the panchromatic day-side emission spectrum of WASP-121b—one of the hottest known UHJs—covering a broad wavelength range of ∼ \sim 0.6-5.1µm, based on archival JWST observations from NIRISS and NIRSpec/G396H.

pmc-11425753.title: Successful rechallenge with Erwinia chrysanthemi asparaginase after pegaspargase-induced hypertriglyceridemia: a case report
pmc-11425753.creator: Gaia Ciolli, Andrea Pasquini, Francesco Mannelli, Barbara Scappini, Giacomo Gianfaldoni, Elisa Quinti, Laura Fasano, Jessica Caroprese, Francesca Crupi, Alessandro Maria Vannucchi, Matteo Piccini
pmc-11425753.description: Polyethylene-glycolated Escherichia coli-derived l-asparaginase (pegaspargase, pASP) is an essential component of paediatric-inspired regimens for the treatment of acute lymphoblastic leukaemia/lymphoma; nonetheless, is characterised by severe and potentially life-threatening toxicities, such as hypertriglyceridemia. Grades 3–4 events have been reported in ~1%–18% of paediatric patients and in sparse reports in adults.

pmc-11713582.title: Factors associated with dementia caregiver burden across multiple Brazilian regions
pmc-11713582.creator: Matheus Ghossain Barbosa, Marcos Antonio Costa Ferreira de Macedo, Fabiana A F da Mata, Ari Alex Ramos, Haliton Alves de Oliveira Júnior, Laiss Bertola, Cleusa P Ferri
pmc-11713582.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundThe number of people with dementia (PWD) is increasing worldwide, and especially in low‐ and middle‐income countries (LMIC). Dementia’s burden extends beyond mortality and healthcare costs. In LMIC, dementia indirect costs are proportionally higher. In Brazil two thirds of the total dementia costs come from informal caregiving, mainly provided by women who quit their jobs to act as a carer for a relative.MethodThe ReNaDe project assessed dementia’s cost, unmet needs, and investment.

pmc-12645440.title: H2S inhibits high glucose-induced osteoblast injury by inhibiting ferroptosis in diabetic osteoporosis in vitro
pmc-12645440.creator: Qingping Shi, Feihong Chen, Wen Wu
pmc-12645440.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Diabetic osteoporosis (DOP) is a complication of prolonged hyperglycemia. Hydrogen sulfide (H2S) has been identified as a protective factor in bone development. However, the mechanism by which H2S antagonizes the effects of high glucose (HG) on osteoblasts remains unclear. The effects of HG and H2S on osteoblasts were assessed through transcriptomic and metabolomic sequencing to identify key changes in gene expression and metabolism.

pmc-13200015.title: Machine Learning for Revision Joint Arthroplasty: A Systematic Review of Distinct Challenges, Current Performance, and Clinical Readiness
pmc-13200015.creator: Teja Yeramosu, Logan K Laubach, Raveena Joshi, Sonya Feeser, Jacob Wait, John Cyrus, Jibanananda Satpathy, Gregory J Golladay, Nirav K Patel
pmc-13200015.description: BackgroundGiven the high complication rates and economic burden of revision total joint arthroplasty, machine learning (ML) models may offer a tool to improve outcomes. This study aims to review the application of ML for predicting outcomes following revision total hip arthroplasty and total knee arthroplasty.

pmc-13466530.title: The impact of probiotic supplementation on mucosal immunity and oxidative stress after high-intensity exercise among athletes: a meta-analysis
pmc-13466530.creator: Chengguo Wang, Yang You, Jilan Zhou
pmc-13466530.description: ObjectiveAthletes engaging in strenuous exercise can experience a heightened risk for upper respiratory symptoms and immune disorders triggered by exercise. This meta-analysis examined the relationship between probiotic supplementation, exercise, mucosal immunity, and oxidative stress (OS) levels following high-intensity exercise.MethodsWe systematically searched four electronic databases to identify eligible studies for subsequent screening.

pmc-13662279.title: Substrate energetics in non-templated DNA synthesis by terminal deoxynucleotidyl transferase
pmc-13662279.creator: Katrina Mogannam, Andrej Lupták
pmc-13662279.description: DNA polymerases typically use deoxyribonucleoside triphosphates (dNTPs) for DNA synthesis, yet the contribution of the γ-phosphate to catalysis remains unclear. Here, we examine the role of substrate energetics in enzyme-catalyzed polymerization using a fidelity-independent model polymerase, terminal deoxynucleotidyl transferase (TdT).

pmc-13685603.title: Targeting NCAPG with Arundanine Suppresses Neutrophil/NET-Mediated Immune Evasion and Enhances CD8+ T Cell Function in Lung Squamous Cell Carcinoma
pmc-13685603.creator: Xuyu Gu, Dongning Lu, Ming Deng, Tao Ge, Kaiqi Jin, Xinnan Xu, Li Xu
pmc-13685603.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Non-SMC condensin I complex subunit G (NCAPG) is implicated in tumor progression and TGF-β pathway activation, yet its roles in oncogenesis and immune modulation within the lung squamous cell carcinoma (LUSC) microenvironment remain largely unexplored.
